text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am Calstone Light O.
Pleased to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I am to run, I will be faster than anyone else.
I am aiming for "maximum speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm not fond of taking detours, so let's head straight for our goal non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
